title: Tenured Vehicle Inspection Workforce with In-House Certified Training, Background-Checked Personnel, and Diverse Subcontractor Teams
capability_statement: We field a fully-staffed, trained, and dependable workforce for vehicle emissions and safety inspection program management, drawing on a dedicated Vehicle Inspection and Compliance division of more than 500 tenured vehicle inspection and compliance professionals plus access to a corporate base of 18,000 employees. Our staffing approach combines an in-place program team with experienced leadership (program managers with 12+ years on prior state inspection programs and 25 years of vehicle I/M industry experience), handpicked DBE/SBE/VBE/VBE subcontractors, and an in-house, certified training capability that operates independently of the inspection workforce so oversight staff are never trained alongside personnel they may later audit. We address mobilization deployment of key personnel, recruitment with backup staffing, substitute-resume submissions, criminal background checks, security awareness and secure-coding training, periodic training renewals, staff qualification monitoring, uniform issuance, and full subcontractor compliance flow-down (Copeland clauses, CWHSSA overtime, EEO non-discrimination, set-aside good-faith documentation). differentiators: Only PennDOT-certified Vehicle Emission Inspection School (VEMIS E200) - we train state program staff in-house, structurally separating oversight personnel from training alongside the I/M personnel they may later audit, eliminating a common conflict-of-interest gap [1973, 1974]. In-place program team with named leadership (Mark Colangelo, VP/PA Program Manager; Mike Butler, VP Smart Vehicles Solutions; Bonnie McPherson, VP Vehicle Inspection Programs; Howard Ubinas, Training Manager with 20 years hands-on inspection-program training experience; Jim Valerio, 25 years industry / 12 years prior state PM tenure) means no transitional risk to current operations and minimal staffing impact in challenging labor markets [1928, 1966, 3643, 3646]. Dedicated Vehicle Inspection and Compliance division of 500+ regional professionals plus 18,000 corporate employees provides surge capacity for mobilization and backup staffing requirements [3671]. Compliance management team of 30+ years working together on inspection programs and 35+ years on program transitions delivers institutional continuity [3655, 3673]. Diverse subcontractor teaming (DBE/SBE/VBE) - PA proposal added two Veteran Business Enterprises (1Alpha Consulting; Berry Solutions Group for enhanced auditor training and I&E) [1928]. Documented scaled training delivery: 95,500+ inspection mechanics trained since 1995 plus 60,000+ via Ontario DriveON 2023 system [3663]. 100+ AWS certifications and corporate strategic investment in AI, cyber, biometrics, cUAS, PFOS/PFAS, and assured PNT supports secure-coding, security-awareness, and specialized-skills training requirements [1963, 3532]. 16-17 consecutive years on Ethisphere's World's Most Ethical Companies list reinforces personnel-conduct and integrity claims [1977, 3524]. Mobilization commitment to deliver all proposed staff trained and state-certified at least 15 days before go-live, with Phase 1 PMO procurement and fit-out [3682].
